item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las khro bcu gsang ba thugs kyi gzer bu
item.coloph: bdag 'dra mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa'am/ g.yung drung bdud 'dul thogs med rtsal gyis bka' gter lhan rgyas su dngos grub thob pas gtan la dbab pa'o//
